title: Dubizzle Bot — Full Bug Fix Sprint (50 bugs)
description: All 50 bugs from QA report. Ordered by batch priority: critical (B1-B9), high (B10-B21), medium (B22-B39), low (B40-B50). Sequential execution within each batch.

tasks.title: Fresh form fills nothing — wait for DOM after category
acceptance_criteria: After category selection, bot waits for first form field to render
Fields are filled with correct values from ad file
Log shows individual field fill confirmations

tasks.title: No file upload input on fresh form
acceptance_criteria: File upload input found after form fields are filled
Photos uploaded successfully on fresh form

tasks.title: Description selector grabs title textarea
acceptance_criteria: Description goes into the description field, not the title field
Title field contains only the title text
Verified via JS evaluate on Dubizzle form

tasks.title: Title doubled on draft resume — Playwright fill appends
acceptance_criteria: Title field shows single copy of title text on draft resume
No duplication or truncation

tasks.title: No price set notification creates phantom waiter
acceptance_criteria: 'No price set' notification sent with wait=False
Next message after notification is processed as new command, not consumed as reply

tasks.title: PermissionError crashes error handler thread
acceptance_criteria: Queue file saves succeed even when briefly locked by another process
No PermissionError tracebacks in logs
Error handler thread doesn't crash

tasks.title: edit_ad_copy blocks main poll thread
acceptance_criteria: Bot remains responsive to messages during edit_ad_copy execution
Edit result still applied correctly to ad file

tasks.title: Price validation after browser launch — wasted work
acceptance_criteria: Price check happens before browser launch and dated copy creation
No wasted AI call or file creation for rooms with [SET PRICE]

tasks.title: Batch cancel only cancels first room
acceptance_criteria: Cancel during batch posting stops ALL remaining rooms
No browser launches for rooms after cancel

tasks.title: change_price modifies live files directly
acceptance_criteria: change_price creates a dated copy before modifying
Original file preserved as backup

tasks.title: edit_ad doesn't protect live files
acceptance_criteria: Edit creates dated copy before applying AI changes regardless of file type
Original file preserved

tasks.title: AI edit adds Room/Villa metadata
acceptance_criteria: AI edit output contains only fields present in original ad
No **Room:** or **Villa:** lines added

tasks.title: Room 02 template format permanently corrupted
acceptance_criteria: Room 02 template starts with # heading
No **Room:** or **Villa:** metadata lines
Format matches other room templates

tasks.title: Dated copies inherit corruption from source
acceptance_criteria: create_dated_copy warns when source format looks wrong
Does not silently propagate corrupted format

tasks.title: Timezone bug — dates use UTC not Dubai
acceptance_criteria: Dated copies use Dubai timezone (UTC+4)
Files created at 11pm Dubai time are dated today, not tomorrow

tasks.title: Typos propagated from template to copies
acceptance_criteria: AI variation fixes obvious typos
Dated copies don't carry source typos

tasks.title: Body price not updated by change_price
acceptance_criteria: Both header price and body price text updated
Old price no longer appears anywhere in the file

tasks.title: No yyyy-mm-dd templates for 5 rooms
acceptance_criteria: yyyy-mm-dd_room-XX template exists for rooms 02, 05, 11, 17, 20
find_ad_file returns type='template' for these rooms

tasks.title: 21 of 29 ad files have [SET PRICE]
acceptance_criteria: Status report shows which rooms have [SET PRICE]
Posting blocked with helpful message for rooms without price

tasks.title: Discount/promo text lost in AI edits
acceptance_criteria: AI edit preserves discount/promo text verbatim
Strikethrough prices and urgency phrases intact

tasks.title: yes after draft creates duplicate
acceptance_criteria: Saying 'yes' after draft creation does not create duplicate
Second 'yes' within 60s is treated as acknowledgment, not new command

tasks.title: Price questions misclassified as status
acceptance_criteria: 'how much is room 14' classifies as preview, not status
Bot shows the ad text including price

tasks.title: Photo count query fails
acceptance_criteria: Bot can answer 'how many photos' questions
Photo count from Selected/ folder included in context

tasks.title: Feature queries unknown
acceptance_criteria: 'which rooms are ensuite' gets a correct answer
Room metadata from rooms.json included in LLM context

tasks.title: Comparison queries unknown
acceptance_criteria: 'compare rooms 01 and 02' returns useful comparison
Both rooms' ad data included in LLM context

tasks.title: Villa-scoped queries unknown
acceptance_criteria: 'show me villa 62 rooms' returns list of rooms in villa 62
Room data filtered by villa number

tasks.title: Room number validation missing
acceptance_criteria: Invalid room numbers rejected with helpful message
Valid range determined from rooms.json, not hardcoded

tasks.title: Bare post infers room from context — risky
acceptance_criteria: 'post' without room number asks which room to post
No silent room inference for posting commands

tasks.title: No undo/revert functionality
acceptance_criteria: 'undo' gets a helpful response about dated copies
Not classified as unknown or sent to AI edit

tasks.title: No delete draft functionality
acceptance_criteria: 'delete draft' gets a helpful response
Not classified as unknown

tasks.title: Photo count not in LLM context
acceptance_criteria: LLM context includes photo count per room
Bot can answer photo-related questions

tasks.title: _gather_context only includes named rooms
acceptance_criteria: Queries about all rooms get data about all rooms
'what rooms have no price set' finds all 21 rooms

tasks.title: edit room with no instruction sends vague prompt
acceptance_criteria: 'edit room 02' with no instruction asks for clarification
Does not call AI with empty/vague instruction

tasks.title: change price inherits stale room from context
acceptance_criteria: 'change price' without room asks which room
'change price' without amount asks what price

tasks.title: show all prices needs escalation to Sonnet
acceptance_criteria: 'show me all the prices' classified without escalation
Response includes prices for all rooms

tasks.title: Messages eaten during concurrent posting
acceptance_criteria: Non-checkpoint messages during posting are queued, not consumed
Queued messages processed after posting flow ends

tasks.title: asyncio Task destroyed but pending errors on cancel
acceptance_criteria: No 'Task destroyed but pending' errors on batch cancel
All async tasks properly cleaned up

tasks.title: Queue allows re-queuing rooms in posting status
acceptance_criteria: Cannot re-queue room already in 'posting' status
Clear error message explaining current status

tasks.title: edit room with no instruction — duplicate of B33
acceptance_criteria: Same as B33

tasks.title: Price formatting inconsistent — no commas
acceptance_criteria: Prices always written with comma separation (5,200 not 5200)
Consistent across all operations

tasks.title: AI variation exceeds 10-20% promise
acceptance_criteria: AI variation changes at most 2-3 words in title
Body structure preserved, only intro paragraph varies

tasks.title: Room 17 title style inconsistent
acceptance_criteria: Room 17 title matches formal style of other room templates

tasks.title: Room 20 title has discount price suffix
acceptance_criteria: Room 20 title clean, no 'discount price!' suffix

tasks.title: Room 05 template typo Beatifull
acceptance_criteria: No spelling errors in room 05 template

tasks.title: Posting aborted raw error shown to user
acceptance_criteria: User-friendly error message with guidance
Mentions which room and how to fix

tasks.title: Draft detection fails on untitled drafts
acceptance_criteria: Untitled drafts detected
Bot asks about existing draft before creating new form

tasks.title: Room 14 dated copy created with SET PRICE
acceptance_criteria: create_dated_copy warns when price is [SET PRICE]
Dated copy not created silently with placeholder price

tasks.title: Queue entries stuck in stale status
acceptance_criteria: Stale 'posting' entries auto-marked failed after timeout
Status report flags stale entries

tasks.title: All rooms query finds only 1 of 21
acceptance_criteria: Same as B32

tasks.title: Multiple checkpoint replies — first dropped
acceptance_criteria: Multiple rapid messages during checkpoint are queued
First message not lost
